title: Normalize executable paper symbols from explicit owner market context; resolve natural SPY signal failure
summary: Resolved natural SPY paper signal execution failure where _strategy_symbol in paper_signal_producer.py validated raw symbol membership against approved artifact parameters but returned bare 'SPY', which downstream executor symbol_parser rejected with SymbolParseError. Implemented authoritative market context resolution leveraging explicit context from binding, artifact metadata/parameters, or market input snapshot without universally appending .US. Integrated normalization via existing adapters (normalize_us_symbol, normalize_taiwan_symbol), added validate_executable_symbol / is_taiwan_venue_symbol / is_executable_symbol to symbol_parser, preserved approved artifact checksum/version/parameters and recorded raw_symbol in signal metadata. Fail-closed semantics strictly enforce market_context_missing, market_context_contradictory, market_context_mismatch, and market_symbol_unexecutable. Verified end-to-end drain through PaperRuntimeService into simulated paper fills and full 73-test regression suite.

executor_parseable_symbols.evidence: Raw bare ticker 'SPY' with US market context normalizes to 'SPY.US' which parses cleanly via symbol_parser.parse() and successfully executes through PaperRuntimeService.drain_once() into paper_fill_simulated events; Taiwan venue symbols ('2330.TW', '2330.TWSE') validate against Shioaji broker boundary.

preserve_approved_artifact_and_raw_membe.evidence: Approved artifact parameters.symbols, artifact_id, version, and checksum are strictly preserved without in-place modification; raw symbol membership check verifies requested symbol matches artifact parameters (e.g. 'MSFT' outside ['SPY'] raises market_input_invalid), and raw_symbol is preserved in emitted signal metadata.

fail_closed_ambiguous_or_contradictory_c.evidence: Never universally appends .US. Bare tickers lacking explicit market context fail closed with market_context_missing; conflicting market contexts (e.g. binding US vs artifact TW) fail closed with market_context_contradictory; intrinsic symbol suffixes conflicting with explicit contexts (e.g. 'AAPL.US' with market 'TW') fail closed with market_context_mismatch.

comprehensive_regressions.evidence: 73 passing tests across test_current_artifact_signal.py, test_paper_signal_producer.py, and test_tw_signal_producer.py covering bare US ticker with explicit context, bare ticker missing context, contradictory contexts, symbol/context mismatches, canonical US/TW symbols, crypto pairs, raw symbol membership validation, wrong artifact version, and direct executor parser verification.

source_only_no_hosted_writes.evidence: Changes are purely source-level within scoped execution runtime files; zero hosted signal, order, or capital writes performed; no new store/controller created; auth and paper/live isolation preserved.
